name: Hyena Hierarchy: Towards Larger Convolutional Language Models
problem: Existing subquadratic attention replacements - low-rank and sparse approximations - have to be mixed with dense attention layers to match Transformer quality, so there is no single subquadratic operator that stands alone.
mechanism: A single implicit long-convolution operator, Hyena, built by interleaving implicitly parameterised long convolutions with data-controlled gating (multiplicative gates driven by the input). The implicit parameterisation (via an MLP generating the convolution kernel weights) is what allows a single operator to have the subquadratic structure while retaining the expressivity that previously forced the hybrid design.
speedup_reported: Paper's own claims (abstract): more than 50 points of accuracy improvement over state-space and other implicit/explicit methods on recall and reasoning at sequence lengths of thousands to hundreds of thousands of tokens; reaching Transformer quality on WikiText103 and The Pile with a 20% reduction in training compute at sequence length 2K; Hyena operators are 2x faster than highly optimised attention at sequence length 8K and 100x faster at sequence length 64K. The speedup figures are operator-level with explicit sequence lengths, which is the right kind of claim.
